S.label: S
S.cue: Tongue tip just behind your top teeth. Let the air hiss out in a thin stream.

Z.label: Z
Z.cue: Same as S, but switch your voice on. Feel your throat buzz.

SH.label: SH
SH.cue: Pull your tongue back a little and round your lips, like saying quiet.

CH.label: CH
CH.cue: Start with your tongue touching, then release into a SH. One quick burst.

JH.label: J
JH.cue: Like CH, but with your voice on from the start.

TH.label: TH
TH.cue: Tongue tip lightly between your teeth. Blow gently — do not bite.

DH.label: TH
DH.cue: Tongue between your teeth like TH, with your voice switched on.

R.label: R
R.cue: Curl or bunch your tongue. It must not touch the roof of your mouth.

L.label: L
L.cue: Tongue tip presses the ridge behind your top teeth. Air escapes at the sides.

K.label: K
K.cue: Back of the tongue lifts to the soft palate, then pops apart.

G.label: G
G.cue: Same as K, with your voice on. Feel the buzz at the back.

F.label: F
F.cue: Top teeth rest on your bottom lip. Blow air through the gap.

T.label: T
T.cue: Tongue tip taps the ridge behind your top teeth, then pops off. Quick and crisp.

D.label: D
D.cue: Same as T, but switch your voice on. Feel your throat buzz as the tip taps.
